title: Gulmarg Gondola: Asia’s Highest Cable Car Ride in Kashmir
content:
Discover the Beauty of Gulmarg Gondola

 Gulmarg Gondola is one of the most popular tourist attractions in Kashmir and the second-highest cable car in the world. Located in the beautiful hill town of Gulmarg, Jammu & Kashmir, this ropeway ride offers breathtaking views of snow-covered mountains, pine forests, and the famous Apharwat Peak. Whether you’re visiting in winter for snow adventures or in summer for scenic views, Gulmarg Gondola is a must-experience attraction.

What is Gulmarg Gondola?

 The Gulmarg Gondola is a cable car system that connects Gulmarg town to higher altitudes of the Pir Panjal range. It operates in two phases and takes tourists close to the snow-clad Apharwat Peak. The gondola ride is famous for its smooth operation, safety, and panoramic Himalayan views.

Phases of Gulmarg Gondola  

Two Journeys, Two Moods

The Gulmarg Gondola operates in two phases, each offering a different experience. The first ride to Kongdoori is calm and family-friendly, while the second ride toward Apharwat Peak takes you higher into the mountains, perfect for adventure and panoramic views.

Phase 1: Gulmarg to Kongdoori

  • Altitude: Around 8,500 ft to 10,000 ft
  • Famous for: Scenic views, snow play, photography
  • Best for: Families and first-time visitors

Phase 2: Kongdoori to Apharwat Peak

  • Altitude: Up to 13,400 ft
  • Famous for: Skiing, snowboarding, high-altitude views
  • Best for : Adventure lovers and experienced travelers

Why Tourists Love Gulmarg Gondola

  • Safe and well-maintained cable car system
  • Spectacular views of the Himalayan range
  • Suitable for families, couples, and groups
  • Easy access to high-altitude locations
  • A peaceful and memorable travel experience

Ticket Booking and Entry Information

Gulmarg Gondola tickets are available only through official online booking platforms. Same-day bookings are usually not recommended due to limited availability, especially during peak tourist seasons.

A valid government ID is required at the boarding point.

A Destination for Every Season

Gulmarg Gondola remains attractive throughout the year.

  • In winter, the region turns into a snow paradise, making it ideal for skiing and snow activities.
  • In summer, the cool climate and green surroundings offer a refreshing escape from city life.

Each season brings a different charm, making the gondola ride worth experiencing at any time of the year.

Nearest Tourist Spots to Gulmarg Gondola

  • Apharwat Peak : Apharwat Peak remains snow-covered most of the year and is a favorite spot for skiing and photography. Read more..
  • Gulmarg Golf Course : One of the highest golf courses in the world, surrounded by pine trees and mountains.
  •  Strawberry Valley : A quiet and scenic spot, perfect for nature walks and photography.
  •  Maharani Temple : A small but beautiful temple located on a hill, offering peaceful vibes and lovely views.

Gulmarg Gondola Ticket Price (Approximate)

  • Phase 1: ₹740 per person
  • Phase 2: ₹950 per person
    (Prices may change-always book from the official website)

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Gulmarg Gondola?
faqs.answer: The best time is from December to March for snow activities and from April to June for pleasant weather and clear views

faqs.question: How can I book Gulmarg Gondola tickets?
faqs.answer: Tickets can be booked online through the official Gulmarg Gondola website. Advance booking is recommended during peak seasons.

faqs.question: Is Gulmarg Gondola the highest cable car in Asia?
faqs.answer: Yes, Gulmarg Gondola is considered Asia’s highest operating cable car system, reaching close to Apharwat Peak.

faqs.question: Is Gulmarg Gondola open throughout the year?
faqs.answer: The gondola generally operates year-round, but services may be suspended temporarily during bad weather or heavy snowfall.

faqs.question: What activities can be done at Gulmarg Gondola?
faqs.answer: Visitors can enjoy sightseeing, photography, snow play, skiing, and panoramic mountain views.
